## How to use:
### 1. Click the "Start a new conversation!" button
### 2. Open the new conversation ( it will create a new thread )
### 3. Ask it a question about Onimator!

-# Notes:
-# - You can ask 10 questions per hour and after you hit the limit, a new conversation will be created in the same thread.
-# - The bot may not have all the answers, and so you can always ask for human assistance in the chat.
-# - If you would like to add the bot to your own server, you can ask its developer: <@587059393766359041> via DM.

embeds.title: Start a new chat!
embeds.description:
Here you can chat with our AI system that will answer all your questions related to Onimator.

There is a limit of 10 messages per hour, so ask questions wisely!

By clicking the button a new conversation will be opened for you!
